newsitem.title: USA: Neurex to discuss pain drug with FDA.
newsitem.headline: Neurex to discuss pain drug with FDA.

text.p: Neurex Corp said Tuesday a meeting has been scheduled with the Food and Drug Administration for the end of March to discuss the progress of its programs for the drug SNX-111 for the treatment of pain.
Neurex said it will discuss its SNX-111 chronic malignant and non-malignant neuropathic pain clinical development programs with the FDA's Scientific Advisory Panel.
It said it intends for the discussions to refine the development plan for the drug, leading to the filing of a New Drug Application.
Neurex said it should have sufficient patient enrollment in 1997 to provide the foundation of an NDA filing.
Since clinical development programs were initiated in pain, head trauma and stroke, 280 patients and healthy human subjects have been treated with SNX-111.
In the analgesia program, over 120 patients have received the drug.
